description: A secret option is never answered. set_preset writes one to .godot/export_credentials.cfg, and remove_preset takes the preset's out of it. Removing the runnable preset makes the next of its platform runnable. Operations: list: the presets in export_presets.cfg; run (needs preset, outputPath): import what changed, then export with a preset; add_preset (needs preset, platform): add an export preset to export_presets.cfg; set_preset (needs preset): change a preset's path, filters and options; remove_preset (needs preset).

customFeatures.description: Custom feature tags the export carries, comma-separated. For op set_preset.

debug.description: A debug export. Default false. For op run.

excludeFilter.description: Files to leave out, as comma-separated patterns such as "*.txt". For op set_preset.

exportFilter.description: What the preset exports. All but all_resources use files. scenes and resources leave out a file named only in a string or by class_name. For op set_preset.

files.description: The files the filter lists, as res:// paths. For op set_preset.

includeFilter.description: Non-resource files to export too, as comma-separated patterns such as "*.json, data/*". For op set_preset.

options.description: Platform options by name, such as {"binary_format/embed_pck": true}. An enum takes the name the dialog shows, or its number. For op set_preset.

outputPath.description: Inside the project. run: where the export is written, and a missing folder is created. add_preset, set_preset: the path the preset stores. Not for ops list, remove_preset.

pack.description: Export the resources alone, as a .pck or .zip by outputPath, with no templates. Not with debug. For op run.

platform.description: The platform the preset exports for. For op add_preset.

preset.description: Preset name from export_presets.cfg. add_preset: the name of the new one. list: answers this preset's options too.

showWindow.description: Linux and macOS: let a preset that bakes shaders export with the editor's window showing. For op run.

name: project_export
title: Export
